description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Worksheet' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, which models and manages a single worksheet within an Excel spreadsheet. It provides methods for cell management, styling, merging, break setting, chart and drawing collection, and various worksheet-specific properties and actions.

classes.name: Worksheet
classes.description: Represents a single worksheet within a spreadsheet, encapsulating cell data, styling, merging, chart collection, and worksheet-specific settings.
